abstract: A 34-year-old man underwent left orchidectomy for his left testicular seminoma. One month later, he developed paraplegia, hypesthesia under Th10 level and vesicorectal disturbance. He was diagnosed as having compressive myelopathy secondary to metastatic neoplasm at thoracic vertebra 10 and its extradural space which were revealed on magnetic resonance imaging. After administration of combination chemotherapy with cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin, the extradural lesions diminished and the neurological symptoms gradually improved. In this case, intradural invasion of tumor cells was suspected because the level of human chorionic gonadotrophin beta subunit (HCG beta) concentration in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) was higher than that in plasma, while radiographic scanning demonstrated regional tumor located at extradural space of Th10 level. It is important to evaluate the spread of tumor cells for the choice of therapy and the monitoring of HCG beta (plasma:CSF ratio) was considered to be one of the useful methods to detect the presence of central nerve system metastases from HCG-producing tumor.
abstract_ja: 34歳男性が左精巣セミノーマに対し精巣摘除術を受けた1か月後、対麻痺、Th10レベル以下の感覚低下および膀胱直腸障害を発症した。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で、胸椎第10椎体および硬膜外腔の転移(性)病変による圧迫性脊髄症と診断された。シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる併用化学療法の後、硬膜外病変は縮小し、神経症状は徐々に改善した。本症例では、脳脊髄液(CSF)中のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピンβサブユニット(β-hCG)濃度が血漿中より高かったため、画像検査ではTh10レベルの硬膜外に限局した病変を認めたにもかかわらず、腫瘍細胞の硬膜内浸潤が疑われた。治療法の選択と経過観察のためには腫瘍細胞の広がりを評価することが重要であり、hCG産生腫瘍による中枢神経転移の検出には、β-hCGの血漿対脳脊髄液比のモニタリングが有用な方法と考えられた。
